answer: Launching many fake identities requires funding fresh stakes across all of them, and the resulting ripple of diluted rewards plus slashed deposits makes the attack cost exceed any gain long prior to the attacker reaches the reputation zenith needed to influence votes. Agents stake a bonded deposit of shale tokens to register, and each epoch's reward share is capped by a decaying reputation score tied to verified peer attestations. Honest agents keep compounding trust while sybils burn capital. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
